sampling: Samples compare marker depth with the nearest opaque pixel. Negative behindMetres puts the recorded surface behind the marker. Visible surface counts cover the actual crown, material within 7.2 m of the tractor head, the moving doors, and the lower hull within 31 m longitudinally, 18 m laterally and -9 to +3.2 m vertically of its hatch. Alpha effects and UI are excluded.
